sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:151

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:151:1
items.html: The heads of his shoulders, which are the two crowns that are in the Daat of ZA; and there, in the Daat, is the place of the standing of the two heads of the shoulders, until there reach those locks of hair. And behold, above he says that the intention is not above, in Arich himself; and here he says that they stand in the Daat of ZA. Indeed, you must remember what was written above (on page 1569, the passage beginning “And this”): that at the time of the coupling ZA is found included in the bottom three thirds of the HGT of AA, which are the heads of his shoulders; and therefore, even after he descends to his place, he takes their discernment with him. And therefore, when AA shines above in the heads of his shoulders, the illumination is found to reach the Daat of ZA in his own place; for the discernment of the Tifferet and the Yesod of the Daat of ZA is literally the discernment of the heads of the shoulders of AA, as above. And since they are one discernment, therefore the illumination of AA above reaches, together with it, the Daat of ZA as well.
